About the Opportunity

OYO is seeking a dynamic and results-driven individual to take on the role of Commercial Executive , focusing on driving business development and fostering strong relationships with our property partners. This position requires a strategic thinker with a passion for building and expanding our network of properties, maximizing revenue opportunities, and ensuring exceptional customer satisfaction.


This Commercial Executive role offers an exciting opportunity to drive business growth, expand OYO's presence in key markets, and contribute to the success of our organization. If you are a motivated and entrepreneurial individual with a passion for business development and hospitality, we invite you to join our team and help us build the most trusted brand in the world.

En OYO buscamos a una persona dinámica y orientada a resultados para ocupar el puesto de Ejecutivo Comercial, centrado en impulsar el desarrollo de negocio y fortalecer las relaciones con nuestros socios propietarios de propiedades. Esta posición requiere de un pensador estratégico con pasión por construir y expandir nuestra red de propiedades, maximizando las oportunidades de ingresos y asegurando una satisfacción excepcional del cliente.


El rol de Ejecutivo Comercial ofrece una oportunidad emocionante para impulsar el crecimiento empresarial, expandir la presencia de OYO en mercados clave y contribuir al éxito de nuestra organización. Si eres una persona motivada y emprendedora con pasión por el desarrollo de negocios y la hospitalidad, te invitamos a unirte a nuestro equipo y ayudarnos a construir la marca más confiable del mundo.

Brief Job Description

As a Commercial Executive , you will play a pivotal role in driving business growth by identifying and engaging with potential business partners to expand OYO's presence in key markets. You will be responsible for developing and executing strategies to attract new properties, negotiate agreements, and drive adoption of the OYO OS model. Additionally, you will work closely with property owners to understand their needs, provide ongoing support, and ensure a seamless onboarding process.

Como Ejecutivo Comercial, jugarás un papel crucial en el impulso del crecimiento empresarial identificando y comprometiéndote con socios comerciales potenciales para expandir la presencia de OYO en mercados clave. Serás responsable de desarrollar y ejecutar estrategias para atraer nuevas propiedades, negociar acuerdos e impulsar la adopción del modelo OYO OS. Además, trabajarás estrechamente con los propietarios de propiedades para comprender sus necesidades, proporcionar apoyo continuo y asegurar un proceso de integración fluido.

Job Overview

The Commercial Executive will be primarily focused on business development initiatives, including prospecting, lead generation, and partnership building. You will leverage your strong communication and negotiation skills to cultivate relationships with property owners, drive adoption of OYO's products and services, and maximize revenue opportunities. In addition to expanding our network of properties, you will also collaborate with internal teams to develop and implement strategies to optimize the performance of existing properties.

El Ejecutivo Comercial se centrará en el desarrollo de negocios, incluyendo la prospección, generación de leads y construcción de asociaciones. Utilizarás tus fuertes habilidades de comunicación y negociación para cultivar relaciones con los propietarios de propiedades, impulsar la adopción de los productos y servicios de OYO y maximizar las oportunidades de ingresos. Además de expandir nuestra red de propiedades, también colaborarás con equipos internos para desarrollar e implementar estrategias que optimicen el rendimiento de las propiedades existentes.

Responsibilities

  • Identify, pursue, and move leads through the sales cycle to expand OYO's network of properties in target markets.
  • Develop and execute strategic business development plans to achieve growth objectives.
  • Negotiate agreements with property owners to onboard new properties onto the OYO platform.
  • Meet with customers/clients face to face & or over the phone.
  • Developing proposals for clients.
  • Provide ongoing support to property owners, including assistance with onboarding, training, and troubleshooting.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to develop and implement strategies to optimize property performance and drive revenue growth.
  • Monitor market trends and competitor activity to identify opportunities for expansion and differentiation.
  • Coordinate pricing strategies with Revenue Managers
  • Ensure room availability (for selling) for the company.
  • Recovery of debt.
  • Churn prevention: Engage with partners to educate them around the solutions Oyo provides and reduce churn.
  • Partner Experience: Ensuring our partners are looked after is critical and so this role is responsible in supporting post onboarding to ensure brand standards, recon statements, commercial understanding (if any) and act as a support function for the partner.
  • Identificar, perseguir y avanzar leads a través del ciclo de ventas para expandir la red de propiedades de OYO en mercados objetivo.
  • Desarrollar y ejecutar planes estratégicos de desarrollo de negocio para alcanzar objetivos de crecimiento.
  • Negociar acuerdos con propietarios de propiedades para integrar nuevas propiedades a la plataforma OYO.
  • Reunirse con clientes cara a cara o por teléfono.
  • Desarrollar propuestas para clientes.
  • Proporcionar apoyo continuo a los propietarios de propiedades, incluyendo asistencia con la integración, capacitación y solución de problemas.
  • Colaborar con equipos internos para desarrollar e implementar estrategias que optimicen el rendimiento de las propiedades y fomenten el crecimiento de ingresos.
  • Monitorear las tendencias del mercado y la actividad de los competidores para identificar oportunidades de expansión y diferenciación.
  • Coordinar estrategias de precios con los Gerentes de Ingresos.
  • Asegurar la disponibilidad de habitaciones (para venta) para la empresa.
  • Recuperación de deudas.
  • Prevención de deserción: Interactuar con socios para educarlos sobre las soluciones que OYO ofrece y reducir la deserción.
  • Experiencia del Socio: Asegurar el bienestar de nuestros socios es crítico y, por tanto, este rol es responsable de apoyar después de la integración para asegurar estándares de marca, entendimientos comerciales y actuar como función de apoyo para el socio.


Job Experience

2-3 years of relevant experience in business development, sales, or related fields, preferably in Real Estate and Hospitality industries.

2-3 años de experiencia relevante en desarrollo de negocios, ventas o campos relacionados, preferiblemente en las industrias de Bienes Raíces y Hospitalidad.


Education

Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Hospitality Management, or a related field.

Licenciatura en Administración de Empresas, Gestión Hotelera o campo relación


Language

Fluent in English (both verbal and written).

Inglés Fluido. Las entrevistas serán realizadas en Inglés.


Skills and qualifications

  • Drive and self-motivation.
  • Networking ability
  • Strong business development skills, with a proven track record of identifying and closing new business opportunities.
  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders.
  • Strategic thinker with the ability to analyze market trends, identify opportunities, and develop actionable plans to drive growth.
  • Results-oriented mindset with a focus on achieving targets and delivering measurable results.
  • Highly organized with strong project management skills and the ability to prioritize and multitask effectively.
  • Automotivación.
  • Capacidad de establecer redes de contacto.
  • Fuertes habilidades de desarrollo de negocio con un historial probado de identificación y cierre de nuevas oportunidades de negocio.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicación y negociación con la capacidad de construir y mantener relaciones con partes interesadas clave.

description:
Somos o maior ressegurador do Brasil. Com mais de 80 anos de experiência, atuamos nas principais linhas de negócios em resseguros e contamos com uma equipe altamente qualificada, pronta para inovar e oferecer os melhores produtos e serviços ao mercado.


Estamos com 1 vaga de Analista de TI Sênior, com foco em Administração de Redes . Confira os detalhes abaixo:


FORMAÇÃO ACADÊMICA


  • Necessário Superior completo em Engenharia de Redes, Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Certificações desejáveis: CCNA, CCNP, Fortinet NSE, CompTIA Network+, ITIL, Azure/AWS Network Engineer Associate.
  • Desejável pós-graduação em Infraestrutura de TI, Segurança da Informação ou Engenharia de Conectividade.


EXPERIÊNCIA/CONHECIMENTOS


  • Imprescindível experiência em administração e suporte de redes corporativas LAN/WAN/Wi-Fi, em ambientes on-premises e cloud;
  • Conhecimento avançado em roteamento, switching, firewalls, NAT, VLANs, QoS e VPNs;
  • Vivência com ferramentas de monitoramento e automação de rede (Zabbix, SolarWinds, PRTG, Ansible);
  • Experiência em ambientes híbridos e multicloud, com integração entre redes locais e provedores cloud;
  • Conhecimento deprotocolos de rede (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, SNMP, BGP, OSPF);
  • Familiaridade com segurança de rede, criptografia, IDS/IPS, segmentação e controle de acesso;
  • Capacidade de diagnóstico e troubleshooting de incidentes complexos de conectividade;
  • Vivência em ambientes corporativos críticos e regulados, com requisitos de alta disponibilidade e compliance;
  • Familiaridade com soluções de rede e segurança Cisco, Palo Alto e Trend Micro;
  • Necessário Inglês técnico intermediário (para leitura de documentação e interface com fornecedores globais).



MISSÃO DA POSIÇÃO


Garantir a operação estável, segura e eficiente das redes de comunicação de dados e voz do IRB(Re), assegurando disponibilidade, desempenho e confiabilidade dos serviços de conectividade corporativa. É o responsável técnico pela infraestrutura de rede, abrangendo LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, VPN, firewalls e equipamentos de comunicação, suportando as operações do negócio e garantindo conformidade com as políticas de segurança e governança de TI.

Assegurar a continuidade e a resiliência das redes corporativas, promovendo padronização, automação e melhoria contínua da infraestrutura de conectividade que sustenta os sistemas críticos e o ambiente híbrido do IRB(Re).


PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES


Gestão e Operação de Ambientes

  • Administrar e monitorar a rede corporativa LAN/WAN/Wi-Fi, em ambientes on-premises e cloud, garantindo disponibilidade, estabilidade e desempenho;
  • Configurar, manter e otimizar switches, roteadores, access points, firewalls, balanceadores e VPNs;
  • Monitorar a latência, throughput e integridade dos enlaces de rede, propondo ações corretivas e preventivas;
  • Executar rotinas de backup e restauração de configurações de rede;
  • Gerenciar e documentar o inventário de equipamentos de rede, seus contratos de manutenção;
  • Apoiar times deService Desk e Infraestrutura na resolução de incidentes relacionados à conectividade;
  • Garantir o cumprimento de SLAs de disponibilidade e performance de rede, com reportes regulares à Governança de TI.


Implementação e Melhoria Contínua

  • Planejar e executar projetos de implantação, atualização e expansão de rede, em alinhamento com Engenharia & Plataforma;
  • Definição de escopo técnico para projetos de infraestrutura de redes, visando escalabilidade e alta disponibilidade dos serviços, garantindo o alinhamento entre requisitos técnicos e necessidades de negócio;
  • Avaliar novas tecnologias e padrões de conectividade (SD-WAN, Wi-Fi 6, 5G, Zero Trust Network Access);
  • Automatizar tarefas de configuração e monitoração com uso de ferramentas de gerenciamento de rede e scripts (Ansible, Python, SNMP, etc.);
  • Apoiar a integração de ambientes on-premises e cloud (Azure, AWS, GCP) garantindo conectividade segura;
  • Participar da definição de arquiteturas de rede resilientes e escaláveis, em conjunto com Arquitetura Corporativa;
  • Documentar diagramas, topologias e fluxos de rede no repositório corporativo de arquitetura;
  • Realizar testesde carga, failover e redundância em enlaces críticos.


Segurança, Governança e Compliance

  • Operar e gerenciar ferramentas de segurança, como: Endpoint Security, NGFW, PAM, WAF, Cloud Email Security, NAC, DNS Security, de acordo as diretrizes do CISO;
  • Monitorar e responder a alertas de segurança de rede, incidentes e vulnerabilidades, em colaboração com o time de Cyber Service;
  • Apoiar auditorias internas e externas, fornecendo evidências de controles e conformidade (LGPD, SUSEP, SOX);
  • Assegurar a execução de atualizações de firmware e patches de segurança nos dispositivos de rede;
  • Gerenciar logs e trilhas de auditoria de equipamentos e soluções de rede;
  • Apoiar o planejamento e execução de planos de continuidade e recuperação de desastres (DRP) para infraestrutura de rede.



BENEFÍCIOS


  • Assistência médica
  • Assistência odontológica

  • Participação nos Lucros ou Resultados
  • Previdência privada
  • Seguro de vida

  • Wellhub (antigo Gympass)

description:
Job Description

Job Title: Assembly and After-Sales Support Technician

Location: Remote position in Brazil with in-person client visits as required

Reports to: Account Manager and CTO

Contract Type: CLT


About LG Sonic: LG Sonic is a global leader in sustainable water quality management, dedicated to developing cutting-edge technologies that help protect water ecosystems. With operations in over 50 countries, we specialize in advanced solutions for algae control, water quality monitoring, and environmental protection. Our award-winning ultrasonic technology, combined with real-time data monitoring, empowers industries, municipalities, and governments to maintain clean and healthy water bodies while reducing chemical use. At LG Sonic, we foster a dynamic and innovative work environment, driven by a passion for sustainability and technological excellence. Join our team and be part of a mission to create cleaner water for future generations.


Position Summary:

The Assembly and After-Sales Support Technician will be responsible for assembling, installing, and maintaining LG Sonic equipment at our clients' sites across various locations in Brazil. In addition to on-site technical duties, the professional will work remotely in an after-sales capacity, providing direct support and maintaining close communication with clients to ensure their needs are met effectively.

Position duties and responsibilities:

  • Assemble and install LG Sonic equipment at client locations throughout Brazil, ensuring proper setup and functionality.
  • Perform routine maintenance, troubleshooting, and repairs on installed equipment to guarantee optimal performance.
  • Travel to client sites as needed to address technical issues and provide on-site support.
  • Provide remote after-sales support, responding to client inquiries, offering technical guidance, and resolving issues via phone, email, or other communication platforms.
  • Maintain direct and proactive communication with clients to ensure satisfaction and address their needs effectively.
  • Document all assembly, maintenance, and support activities, preparing detailed reports for internal records and client follow-ups.
  • Collaborate with the LG Sonic team to identify opportunities for equipment improvements or upgrades based on client feedback and field observations.
  • Adhere to safety protocols and company standards during all on-site and remote activities.


Qualification and requirements:

  • Must reside in Brazil and be willing to travel frequently to client sites across the country with flexibility to adapt to varying schedules.
  • Excellent communication skills in Portuguese and English (written and spoken) for client interactions, technical support, and reporting.
  • Proven experience in equipment assembly, installation, and maintenance, preferably in a technical or industrial setting.
  • Strong problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work independently in the field and remotely, with strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • Familiarity with remote support tools and basic computer skills for documentation and communication.
  • Valid driver’s license and ability to operate safely in diverse working environments.
  • Previous experience in after-sales or customer support roles is a plus.


Why Join LG Sonic? At LG Sonic, we offer an exciting and collaborative work environment where your contributions directly impact our mission of environmental sustainability and innovation. By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to grow professionally while being a part of a global leader in water treatment technology. We believe in investing in our people and fostering an inclusive culture where every team member’s ideas are valued.


LG Sonic Values : Unity, Trust, Positivism, Over deliver and Passion.


Application Process: If you are interested in joining LG Sonic, we encourage you to apply by following these steps:

  • Submit Your CV: Please send your updated CV in English to with the subject line: Assembly and After-Sales Support Technician .
  • Apply via Recruitment Platforms: You may also apply through recruitment websites where this position is posted. Please ensure your CV is submitted in English .
  • Application Review: Our HR team will carefully review all applications and contact shortlisted candidates for the next steps.
  • Interview Process: Selected candidates will be invited for interviews to assess their skills, experience, and suitability for the role.

You are a Data Architect with a strong focus on designing, optimizing, and scaling high-performance data solutions. description:
Vaga: Vendedor Externo Consultivo (B2B) – RJ

Empresa: Dallminas


Modelo de trabalho: Remoto / Com visitas externas

Local de atuação: Rio de Janeiro/RJ (foco em Capital, com possíveis visitas pontuais à Região dos Lagos e região industrial)


Objetivo da posição

Expansão de mercado e aumento de presença regional no Rio de Janeiro.

O papel central desta posição é estar próximo do mercado, no lugar certo, com as pessoas certas, e construir uma base comercial sólida para crescimento consistente.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Atuar em campo com vendas técnicas e consultivas (ciclo de médio e longo prazo), com foco em presença e relacionamento
  • Visitar clientes certos (oportunidades) — a empresa não realiza visitas “para prospectar por prospecção”
  • Equilibrar a rotina entre:
  • Gestão de carteira (clientes ativos serão repassados para maximizar potencial)
  • Reativação de clientes inativos
  • Prospecção ativa em contas com pré-filtragem
  • Atuação com leads qualificados repassados pelo time de SDR
  • Registrar e operar o funil comercial no CRM
  • Participar de reuniões diárias (dailys) e checkpoint semanal (relatório)
  • Trabalhar com metas e indicadores claros (ex.: faturamento, margem, recorrência, volume (ton) e mix de produtos )
  • Acionar e se integrar ao time técnico para agendamento de visitas/calls quando necessário, garantindo especificações técnicas corretas


Produtos e perfil de cliente

Portfólio (linha de químicos para construção): selantes (silicone, PU, acrílicos), impermeabilizantes de diversos tipos.

Perfil de clientes atendidos: construtoras, aplicadores, empreiteiros e, em alguns casos, clientes finais/investidores do ramo imobiliário.


Perfil técnico esperado

  • Vivência em vendas B2B
  • Domínio de CRM (disciplina de processo e registro)
  • Conhecimento e aplicação de técnicas de venda, e condução de jornada longa

Formação desejável: Engenharia, Arquitetura ou Administração

Diferencial: conhecimento de canteiro de obras (como funciona uma obra, quem são as pessoas e como se dá a decisão).


Perfil comportamental

Buscamos uma pessoa:

  • Com mentalidade consultiva genuína , escuta ativa e leitura de cenário
  • Com disciplina comercial e respeito ao processo
  • Não imediatista (entende que o “sim” leva tempo e que o começo tende a ser mais lento)
  • Perfil híbrido com predominância clara: autônomo + resiliente + relacional , com execução disciplinada

Não se adapta a esta vaga quem:

  • É imediatista e obcecado por fechamento rápido
  • Atua como “vendedor de produto” (e não de solução)
  • Empurra solução inadequada (falta de ética técnica)


Indicadores de sucesso (3 a 6 meses)

  • Absorver cultura e construir autonomia real na rotina
  • Qualidade e consistência do uso do CRM
  • Integração com time técnico
  • Evolução no aprendizado técnico (início de especificações técnicas)
  • Primeiros fechamentos realizados com consistência


Informações da vaga:

  • Regime de contratação: CLT
  • Remuneração fixa: R$3.500
  • Comissão variável: 1 a 4% sobre as vendas
  • Carga horária: 44h semanais
  • Benefícios: carro, combustível e vale-alimentação.


Se para você vender gosta de criar relacionamento com o cliente, e concorda que vender não é empurrar produto, e sim construir confiança, essa vaga pode ser sua!

title: Creator & Influencer Sourcing Specialist
description:
About ContentJet

ContentJet is a global creative production company specializing in high-performing UGC and creator-led ads for brands advertising on platforms like TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube.


Our model combines a global network of creators, performance-driven creative strategy, and AI-assisted production systems to produce large volumes of social media content at scale.

As demand grows, we are expanding our global creator network and building one of the most efficient creator supply systems in the industry.


We are hiring a Head of Creator Partnerships & Expansion to lead this effort.


The Role

We are looking for a highly organized, internet-savvy Creator & Influencer Sourcing Specialist to serve as the tactical engine that keeps our creative projects moving. Your mission is to fill creator casting needs fast and accurately by turning client requirements into qualified, client-ready shortlists. You are the ultimate talent scout—spending your days hunting for the perfect creators, reaching out directly, and securing the right candidates for our campaigns.


What You Will Do

  • Creator Hunting & Sourcing: You will build structured sourcing plans to hunt for external creators across social platforms. You will use search signals and keywords to find niche talent quickly, rather than relying on luck.
  • Outbound Outreach & Pitching: You will execute high-volume outbound outreach via DMs and emails. You will clearly explain the project scope and requirements, pitching the opportunity to creators in a concise, persuasive way.
  • Negotiating & Confirming Terms: You will negotiate and confirm practical constraints with the creators, including their availability, delivery timelines, location, and usage rights terms.
  • Requirement Translation: You will turn messy client input into a crisp casting spec, identifying exact must-haves, lifestyle cues, and brand risk exclusions so you know exactly who to look for.
  • Upfront Quality Screening: You will protect quality upfront by validating a creator's audio/lighting viability, their on-camera tone and presence, and their ability to show products naturally.
  • Finding the Right Options (Shortlisting): You will build highly curated shortlist packs featuring 5-12 primary creator options that perfectly match the brief, packaging their links, bios, and performance vibes for client approval.


What You Won't Do

We believe in strict operational boundaries so you can focus entirely on talent discovery:

  • You stop at approval. Once your shortlist of creators is approved by the client, you hand off the execution to the Creative Fulfillment Specialist.
  • You do NOT own: formal contract execution, scheduling, shipping tracking, chasing deliverables, or paying the creators.


Skills & Experience Needed

  • 2+ years of concrete professional experience in influencer marketing, talent sourcing, creator casting, or a heavily outbound-focused outreach role.
  • Influencer / Creator Discovery: You have proven experience actively hunting and finding influencers or UGC creators for brand campaigns. You know the ins and outs of searching TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube for niche talent.
  • Outreach & Negotiation: You are an expert at persuasive outreach copy. You can DM or email creators without sounding spammy, clearly explain a project's scope, and get fast "yes/no" decisions.
  • Vetting Judgment: You have a strong eye for what makes a creator a good fit for performance UGC and you maintain strong brand safety awareness.
  • Pacing & Organization: You track many candidates simultaneously and maintain strong documentation habits.
  • Language Fluency: Fluent written English is absolutely required for crafting persuasive pitches and clear internal documentation. Written fluency in Spanish is highly preferred (though not mandatory).


How We Measure Success

  • Speed: The time it takes you to move from a new casting ticket to a fully built shortlist.
  • Quality: High shortlist acceptance rates by our clients and a low creator mismatch rate (meaning the creators you find actually succeed on the project).
  • Efficiency: The daily volume of qualified creator leads you add to our bench through your outbound outreach.

Why Join Us?

  • 100% Fully Remote: Work from wherever you are most productive.
  • Quarterly Bonuses: We reward high performance with structured quarterly bonuses tied directly to your impact.
  • Fast-Growing Company: Join a rapidly scaling startup where your work directly shapes the company's trajectory and bottom line.
  • Build From the Ground Up: You will have the ultimate autonomy to design, test, and build our macro-growth systems and team operations exactly how you envision them.
  • Opportunities to Grow: As you scale our creator network and build out our operations, there will be clear, accelerated pathways to grow your career and your team within the company.

title: Senior Mainframe Automation Engineer
description:

O candidato ideal terá um papel crítico para garantir a eficiência operacional, a disponibilidade dos sistemas e processos de automação contínuos em um ambiente z/OS complexo.

Você irá colaborar de perto com a equipe de Automação para implementar soluções de automação baseadas em políticas, reduzir a sobrecarga administrativa e aumentar a capacidade de resposta dos sistemas. Esta posição não impacta o desenvolvimento de aplicações, mas influencia significativamente as estratégias e operações de automação.”


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Liderar projetos de migração de CA OPS/MVS para IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS e de CA Automation Point para IBM SAIOM.
  • Configurar e implementar soluções IBM Systems Automation, incluindo automação baseada em políticas para ambientes z/OS.
  • Desenvolver e manter regras de automação, execs REXX e configurações do System Automation Policy Database (PDB) .
  • Prestar suporte na instalação e configuração de produtos de automação da IBM.
  • Colaborar com as equipes de operações para otimizar processos de inicialização, desligamento e recuperação dos sistemas.
  • Garantir alta disponibilidade e eficiência dos sistemas críticos por meio de estratégias proativas de automação.
  • Documentar processos, configurações e etapas de migração, garantindo comunicação clara com as partes interessadas.
  • Identificar e resolver problemas relacionados à automação em ambientes de produção.


Quais são as habilidades obrigatórias e níveis de proficiência exigidos para esta posição?

  • Experiência em Operações de Mainframe: Mínimo de 5+ anos em ambiente de operações de mainframe, em funções operacionais, de serviços, consultoria ou suporte.
  • IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS: Conhecimento avançado e experiência prática.
  • CA OPS/MVS: Avançado.
  • TSO e ISPF: Proficiência no uso dessas ferramentas para gerenciamento de sistemas.
  • JCL: Fortes habilidades em Job Control Language.
  • Programação REXX: Capacidade de escrever e manter scripts REXX.
  • System Automation Policy Database (PDB): Conhecimento prático obrigatório.
  • Experiência em Migração: Histórico comprovado em projetos de migração de automação em z/OS.
  • NetView for z/OS: Experiência na implementação e utilização deste produto.
  • Scripting REXX: Avançado.

  • Conhecimento de outros softwares IBM Z, incluindo operação, configuração e automação de sistemas.
  • Familiaridade com processos de inicialização e desligamento do sistema z/OS.
  • Experiência com SMP/E para instalação e manutenção de software.

title: Master Data Modeler
description:
Position Summary and Location

Support the design, development, and maintenance of master data models that ensure the accuracy and consistency of key business data across systems. Collaborate with senior team members to model data structures and optimize data flow, supporting various departments such as finance, sales, and operations. This position is ideal for someone with a passion for data modeling, a keen eye for detail, and a desire to grow in data management and governance.


Duties and Responsibilities

  • Assist in the design and development of master data models for master domains such as customer, assets, supplier, and financial data.
  • Help create and maintain data models (conceptual, logical, and physical) that align with business needs and data governance policies.
  • Ensure the accuracy and integrity of master data by supporting data modeling standards and best practices.
  • Analyze data from various sources to support data modeling decisions and validate the accuracy and completeness of master data.
  • Perform basic data profiling and quality checks to identify patterns, anomalies, and potential improvements in data structures.
  • Collaborate with data quality and data governance teams to ensure consistency across systems.
  • Assist in designing data flow diagrams and documenting data mappings between different systems.
  • Work with data engineers and system architects to integrate master data models with existing databases and applications.
  • Support the creation of data management workflows that optimize data retrieval, storage, and reporting processes.
  • Help maintain documentation for master data models, including data definitions, relationships, and lineage.
  • Prepare reports and presentations on data modeling findings and recommendations to stakeholders and team members.
  • Contribute to the development of metadata repositories and data dictionaries to support enterprise data governance.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in data management, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • Relevant coursework or project experience in data modeling, databases, or data management is a plus.
  • Basic understanding of data modeling concepts (e.G., entity-relationship models, dimensional modeling) and database structures.
  • Familiarity with data modeling tools such as Erwin, IBM InfoSphere Data Architect, SAP PowerDesigner, or similar tools.
  • Proficiency in SQL for querying databases and understanding relational data structures.
  • Some exposure to data governance principles, master data management (MDM), and data integration processes.


Desired Qualifications

  • Hands-on project experience in data modeling, data management, or database design.
  • Experience working with relational database management systems (RDBMS) such as Oracle, SQL Server, or MySQL.
  • Familiarity with metadata management and data dictionary tools is a plus.

title: Lead Engineer
description:
We Are Sportingtech :


Sportingtech is a multi-award-winning provider of turnkey betting and gaming solutions designed for regulated and emerging markets around the world. With offices in Malta, Bulgaria, London, Brazil and Portugal, our iGaming platform offers everything covering sportsbook and casino via a modular system and intuitive back office for a fully omni-channel solution. Our unparalleled ability to cater for local-market customisation and operator preferences provides players with an optimal betting experience, resulting in proven growth for our rapidly expanding customer base.



Where you Fit In:


As a JAVA Lead Engineer , you are a senior, hands-on engineer responsible for designing and delivering high-quality Java-based solutions in a transactional, distributed environment. You shape and execute technical direction in close collaboration with Architecture and Principal Engineers, ensuring the team’s implementation aligns with agreed standards, target architecture, and operational constraints.


The impact you will have:


Hands-on engineering & delivery (primary)

  • Design, implement, and maintain backend services and APIs primarily in Java (and relevant frameworks) with strong engineering discipline.
  • Own complex technical work end-to-end: implementation, testing, deployment readiness, and production validation.
  • Drive high-quality code practices: reviews, refactoring, performance tuning, and technical debt management.


Technical leadership in partnership

  • Collaborate with Architects and Principal Engineers to align on technical direction, reference architectures, and platform standards.
  • Translate architectural direction into executable team-level designs: service boundaries, integration patterns, transactional consistency, and data-access strategy.
  • Lead technical discovery/spikes and propose pragmatic options with trade-offs.


Transactional systems & data engineering

  • Design for correctness and integrity using transactional databases (SQL, schema evolution, indexing, query performance).
  • Handle concurrency, consistency models, idempotency, and failure modes (retries, sagas/outbox patterns where applicable).
  • Ensure safe migrations and backward-compatible changes to data structures and service contracts.


Mentorship & team enablement

  • Mentor engineers through pairing, code reviews, design sessions, and technical coaching.
  • Raise team capability in Java engineering practices, distributed systems thinking, and operational hygiene.


Quality, reliability, and operability (“build it, run it”)

  • Embed robust testing aligned to service criticality working closely with Quality Assurance Engineers.
  • Partner with Performance Engineers and IT Operations to ensure operational readiness: monitoring, alerting, dashboards, runbooks, and production access patterns.
  • Participate in incident response as needed;
    work with the incident team on follow-ups (RCA actions, preventative fixes, resilience improvements).



What we’re looking for:


We are looking for a Technical Leader with solid experience in Java and related technologies.


  • Degree in Computer Science or equivalent field.
  • Professional software engineering experience, with substantial hands-on backend/service work.
  • Strong Java expertise and common ecosystem frameworks (e.G., Spring / similar) and build/test tooling.
  • Strong SQL and transactional DB fundamentals (modeling, migrations, performance, locking/concurrency implications).
  • Distributed systems fundamentals: latency, resiliency patterns, observability, and debugging in production.
  • Strong testing discipline;
    familiarity with CI/CD best practices.
  • Demonstrable ownership of production systems in a transactional domain.
  • Advanced English.
  • Clear communication and alignment skills across Architecture, Principal Engineers, Product, QA, NOC, and IT Ops.


This role is Remote based in Brazil.

We value diversity and are committed to providing a work environment of mutual respect to everyone without regard to race, colour, religion, national origin, age, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances. title: Desenvolvedor Backend Node Senior
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


O que buscamos?

Buscamos um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Backend Sênior com experiência sólida em Node.Js (JavaScript) , que tenha atuado no desenvolvimento de aplicações backend e APIs REST.

Esperamos um profissional com vivência em testes e documentação de APIs, garantindo qualidade, organização e clareza nas entregas técnicas.

Valorizamos um perfil autônomo, colaborativo e comprometido com boas práticas de desenvolvimento, que contribua ativamente para a evolução das soluções e do time.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho?

  • Testar e documentar APIs Rest e Async API;
  • Trabalhar com arquiteturas de software, como monolito, microserviços, Event-Driven Architecture, Hexagonal Architecture, e DDD;
  • Gerenciar versionamento de código com Git;
  • Implementar e gerenciar Containers utilizando Docker e Docker Compose;
  • Configurar e utilizar pipelines de CI/CD;
  • Trabalhar com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais (MongoDB);
  • Processar tarefas assíncronas com message brokers, como Azure Service Bus, EventHub, Apache Kafka, AWS SQS, e RabbitMQ;
  • Implementar soluções utilizando os protocolos HTTP, AMQP, TCP, e TLS.


O que você precisa ter:

  • Experiência com desenvolvimento em NodeJs (Javascript);
  • Experiência comtestes e documentação de API Rest e Async API;
  • Conhecimentos em arquiteturas de software, como:
  • Monolito;
  • Microserviços;
  • Event-Driven Architecture;
  • Hexagonal Architecture;
  • DDD (Domain-Driven Design);
  • Experiência comferramentas de versionamento de código (Git);
  • Experiência comContainers utilizando Docker e Docker Compose;
  • Experiência em CI/CD;
  • Experiência combancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais (MongoDB);
  • Experiência comprocessamento assíncrono utilizando message brokers, como:
  • Azure Service Bus;
  • EventHub;
  • Apache Kafka;
  • AWS SQS;
  • RabbitMQ;
  • Compreensão dosdiferentes tipos de protocolo:
  • HTTP, AMQP, TCP, TLS.


Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento em Azure Cloud, como Azure ServiceBus, EventHub, AKS, e App Insights.
  • Línguas: Desejável inglês técnico e/ou espanhol.


Onde você irá trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.

buscamos também transmitir uma sensação de segurança e tranquilidade, permitindo que essas empresas se concentrem no crescimento e na inovação de seus negócios.

Na GoCache, você fará parte da criação e evolução de serviços backend de alta performance focados em segurança de APIs, detecção de fraudes e proteção em tempo real. Tudo o que você construir impactará diretamente a confiabilidade e inovação dos produtos que chegam aos nossos clientes.

Por que vale a pena

title: Research Engineer, Multimodal
description:
The Role

We are looking for a Research Engineer, Multimodal to help deliver frontier-quality multimodal datasets, evaluations, and RL environments that improve state-of-the-art models for leading AI labs and enterprise clients.


This is a hands-on, research-facing technical role. You will work directly with customer researchers and engineers to turn their multimodal model improvement goals into concrete data specs — designing tasks that test genuine cross-modal reasoning, not just text comprehension with images attached.


We're targeting candidates with roughly 4–5 years of experience building or improving multimodal AI systems — especially where strong results depended on data curation across modalities, evaluation design, or building systems that handle the complexity of real-world documents, charts, and visual interfaces.


What You'll Do

1. Design and deliver multimodal datasets and evaluation environments

  • Work with customer researchers to define data requirements for multimodal capabilities: chart reading, document QA, UI understanding, diagram-based reasoning, OCR-aware tasks, and visual grounding.
  • Design task suites that test true multimodal reasoning — tasks where the answer requires integrating information across text, images, tables, and document structure, not just surface-level pattern matching.
  • Build ground-truth signals and verification systems for multimodal tasks, where correctness often depends on spatial relationships, visual context, and cross-reference between modalities.
  • Define task formats and data schemas that capture the full richness of multimodal inputs while remaining tractable for model training.


2. Build quality and validation systems for multimodal data

  • Perform deep audits of produced data — spotting subtle errors in visual grounding, incorrect chart readings, OCR artifacts, layout misinterpretations, and ambiguous visual references.
  • Implement automated validation: consistency checks across modalities, format and schema validation, deduplication, and difficulty/diversity controls.
  • Where appropriate, develop synthetic data generation pipelines: programmatic chart/table generation, document layout templating, controlled visual perturbations, and augmentation across visual conditions.

3. Prove impact through evaluations and training runs

  • Design and run evals targeting multimodal capabilities aligned with customer goals.
  • Produce analysis connecting data to outcomes: pre/post comparisons on targeted multimodal tasks, error breakdowns by modality and task type, and ablations identifying which data attributes drive model lift.
  • When needed, run fine-tuning or RL experiments (or partner with research) to demonstrate measurable multimodal improvement.

4. Collaborate with cross-functional delivery teams

  • Provide clear specs, visual examples, and edge cases to engineers, QAs, domain SMEs, and data production groups.
  • Run fast feedback loops grounded in multimodal quality metrics.
  • Review and improve outputs from large-scale multimodal data creation efforts, maintaining a high bar for cross-modal correctness and realism.


Who We're Looking For

1. Required Qualifications

  • 4–5 years of experience building or improving AI systems involving multimodal data — images, documents, charts, tables, or visual interfaces combined with text.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one of: document understanding, chart/diagram reasoning, OCR systems, UI understanding, or vision-language models.
  • Strong intuition for what makes a good multimodal task: genuine cross-modal reasoning requirements, clear ground truth, and resistance to text-only shortcuts.
  • Demonstrated ability to be extremely detail-oriented — you catch when a chart label is misread, a table cell is misaligned, or a visual reference is ambiguous.
  • Python proficiency required;
    comfort with SQL and structured data workflows strongly preferred.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with researchers and engineers — turning multimodal model goals into concrete data specs.


2. Highly valued experience

  • RL or post-training experience: RLHF/RLAIF, reward modeling, verifier training, or environment design applied to multimodal tasks.
  • Experience with vision-language models (CLIP, LLaVA, GPT-4V, Gemini, or equivalent).
  • Agentic evaluation involving visual grounding: browser-use agents, UI navigation, or screen-based task completion.
  • Experience building evaluation frameworks or benchmarks for multimodal systems.
  • Audio/video understanding experience (optional but valued).


Why Turing

  • Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the multimodal datasets and evaluations training the next generation of vision-language models.
  • Real impact: your data will directly shape how models learn to read charts, understand documents, navigate interfaces, and reason across modalities.
  • Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.


Why Turing

  • Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the RL environments powering post-training for frontier models.
  • Real impact: your environments and reward systems will directly shape how models learn to reason, act, and improve.
  • Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.


Values:

  • We are client first : We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
  • We work at Start-Up Speed: We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
  • We are Al forward: We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.


Advantages of joining Turing:

  • Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment;
    5 days a week)
  • Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)
  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours


Don’t meet every single requirement?

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. Turing is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. At Turing we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace and celebrate authenticity, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

title: Brazil - Remote: Data Engineer - Platform & Pipelines
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.


Job Duties

We are implementing a strict Medallion Architecture to organize petabytes of industrial data. This role is for a Data Engineer who excels at transforming raw chaos into structured, queryable assets.

You will build and maintain the ELT pipelines that move data from "Bronze" (Raw) to "Silver" (Cleaned) and "Gold" (Aggregated). You will work with Delta Lake (On-prem/Databricks), Polars and Airflow to ensure data quality and availability for Data Scientists and the Knowledge Graph.

What You’ll Do

  • Pipeline Development: Develop and maintain robust Airflow DAGs to orchestrate complex data transformations.
  • Data Transformation: Use Spark (when scale requires) and Polars to clean, enrich, and aggregate data according to business logic.
  • Architecture Implementation: Enforce the Medallion Architecture patterns, ensuring clear separation of concerns between data layers.
  • Performance Tuning: Optimize processing workflows (Polars/Spark) jobs and SQL queries to reduce costs and execution time;
    make intelligent decisions on when to use Polars vs. Spark.
  • Deployment & Operations: Manage code deployment to on-prem and cloud infrastructure, including containerization and environment configuration.
  • Data Quality: Implement comprehensive data validation checks and quality gates between medallion layers.
  • Data Cataloging: Maintain the metadata and catalog entries to ensure all data assets are discoverable and documented.

The Technology Stack

  • Orchestration: Apache Airflow.
  • Data Processing: Polars (primary for ETL), PySpark/SQL (for massive scale)
  • Compute : Single-node workers (Polars), Databricks/Spark clustrers (when scale requires)
  • Storage: Delta Lake, Parquet, S3/Blob Storage, MinIO
  • Language: Python 3.12+ (w/ Polars), SQL.


Qualifications


Must Haves:

  • Complete Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related.
  • 3+ years of experience in Data Engineering.
  • Strong proficiency in Apache Airflow and Databricks .
  • Experience implementing Medallion/Delta Lake architectures.
  • Strong SQL and Python skills.
  • Advanced English communication skills.

Good to Have:

  • Experience with Unity Catalog or other governance tools.
  • Familiarity with dbt (data build tool).
  • Background in processing telemetry or sensor data.


Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • The Structured Thinker: You love organizing data. You understand the importance of schemas, data typing, and normalization.
  • Quality Obsessive: You don't just move data;
    you test it. You implement checks to ensure no bad data reaches the Gold layer.
  • Pipeline Builder: You view data engineering as software engineering. You write modular, reusable code for your transformations.

title: Ui/Ux Designer
description:
UI/UX Designer

Full-Time | Brazil (Hybrid) | Mid–Senior Level


About the Role

We build technology products for companies that are reshaping how industries operate. Our design team sits at the intersection of product strategy, engineering, and user research, and the work we do ships to real users.


This is not a purely visual design role. Designers here influence product direction, collaborate closely with engineers and product leaders, and help define how complex systems should actually work.


We are looking for a UI/UX Designer who can move fluidly between ambiguous discovery work and pixel-precise execution. You will partner with product managers, engineers, and client stakeholders to design experiences that are strategically sound and deeply usable.


What You'll Do

- Own design end-to-end for one or more product workstreams, from research and wireframes through final developer handoff

- Facilitate discovery sessions with clients and internal teams to clarify problems before jumping into solutions

- Produce high-fidelity prototypes and detailed design specifications that engineers can build from with minimal iteration

- Conduct usability testing and translate insights into actionable design improvements

- Contribute to and help maintain shared design systems across multiple products

- Present design rationale clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including client leadership

- Collaborate with product managers to define success metrics for design decisions and evaluate outcomes after launch

What We're Looking For


Must-Have Experience

- 3+ years of product design experience, ideally within a startup, consultancy, or fast-paced product environment

- Strong portfolio demonstrating systems thinking and problem solving, not just visual design

- Advanced proficiency with Figma including components, auto-layout, variables, and interactive prototyping

- Experience designing for both web and mobile platforms with awareness of technical constraints

- Ability to communicate design decisions in terms of user impact and business value

- Comfortable working in ambiguous environments where problems are not fully defined


Nice to Have

- Experience designing products for enterprise or B2B users

- Familiarity with front-end development concepts such as HTML, CSS, or React fundamentals

- Experience with service design or end-to-end journey mapping for complex products

- Experience building or scaling a design system from the ground up


How We Work

Our teams operate in short delivery cycles with tight collaboration between design, product, and engineering. We prioritize fast decision making, direct communication, and high ownership.


We partner with organizations across industries including healthcare, financial services, logistics, and enterprise software. Projects range from building new products from scratch to modernizing complex legacy platforms.


What You'll Get

- Competitive base salary with performance-based compensation

- Comprehensive health, dental, and vision benefits

- Flexible remote-first environment with optional in-person collaboration

- Exposure to a wide range of industries and product challenges

- A design-focused team that values craft and pushes each other to produce exceptional work

title: Desenvolvedor Servicenow | Especialista Técnico De Aplicações
description:
Descrição da Vaga (JD):

O desenvolvedor ServiceNow fará parte de uma equipe já estabelecida, apoiando a implementação do módulo Application Portfolio Management (APM) do ServiceNow. O profissional será responsável por ativar e configurar o módulo, além de trabalhar em estreita colaboração com os times funcionais para definir o escopo e os objetivos do sistema.


Como Especialista Técnico de Aplicações, você poderá esperar:

▪ Formular e definir o escopo e os objetivos do sistema.

▪ Ser responsável pelo design do programa, codificação, testes, depuração e documentação.

▪ Ter conhecimento técnico e responsabilidade por todas as fases de análise e programação de sistemas de aplicações.

▪ Compreender o negócio ou a função para a qual a aplicação está sendo projetada.

▪ Aprender continuamente sobre novas tecnologias, gerar novas ideias e melhorar o uso de tecnologias modernas em todo o portfólio de aplicações.

▪ Configurar e ativar o Application Portfolio Management (APM).

▪ Desenvolver relacionamentos de Itens de Configuração (CIs) para Capacidades de Negócio, Objetos de Informação, Aplicações de Negócio e Serviços de Aplicação.

▪ Integrar o APM com outros módulos do ServiceNow, incluindo ITSM e SAM.

▪ Utilizar fortes competências técnicas e expertise para identificar, analisar e solucionar problemas em produção, mantendo procedimentos que atendam às expectativas dos usuários de negócio.

▪ Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com equipes multifuncionais e times de desenvolvimento para entender e fornecer soluções/correções automatizadas.

▪ Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos de Delivery e Suporte, bem como para a maturidade dos diferentes portfólios, capacidades, especializações e melhores práticas, considerando as necessidades e requisitos dos usuários e stakeholders.

▪ Participar de eventos SCRUM e concluir os itens atribuídos dentro da meta definida para a Sprint.

▪ Reunir-se com stakeholders-chave e acompanhar os itens de ação para quaisquer soluções alternativas necessárias, de acordo com a natureza dos requisitos.

Qualificações e Requisitos


Qualificações essenciais

- Graduação ou Mestrado em Computação, Eletrônica ou área relacionada

- Certificação ServiceNow System Administrator (CSA)

- Certificação ServiceNow Certified Application Portfolio Management (APM) Implementer

- Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, com capacidade de comunicar informações técnicas para públicos não técnicos


Competências-chave

▪ 8 a 10 anos de experiência total na área de TI

▪ Conhecimento intermediário em linguagens de desenvolvimento: XML, HTML, CSS, Java e JavaScript

▪ Experiência na plataforma ServiceNow como Administrador e Desenvolvedor

▪ Experiência no desenvolvimento de Service Catalogs, implementação de ACLs, transform maps, Flows via Flow Designer, client scripts e métricas de saúde da CMDB

▪ Configuração de Assessments, Demands, Business Capability Maps e Information Objects

▪ Mais de 5 anos de experiência em administração ServiceNow nas seguintes áreas: Service Catalog, CMDB & Discovery, Service Portal, Workflows, Dashboards, REST APIs

▪ Experiência prévia com o módulo APM é desejável


Outras habilidades e competências

▪ Capacidade de adaptação rápida para aprender novas ferramentas, novas tecnologias e padrões atuais do mercado

▪ Capacidade de trabalhar em ambiente global e distribuído, sem supervisão

▪ Perfil autodirigido, proativo e com pensamento sistêmico

title: Analista De Folha De Pagamento (Esocial) - São Paulo/Sp
description:

title: Latam-focused research intern
description:
About BCP Securities Group
Founded in 1989, BCP Securities, Inc. is an American brokerage and investment bank focused on fixed income in emerging markets. Headquartered in Greenwich, Connecticut, with offices in strategic cities such as Rio de Janeiro, Miami, Los Angeles, Madrid, Mexico City, and Singapore, BCP is a global reference in customized financial solutions. Recognized for its excellence and ethical commitment, the company offers innovative and effective services to meet the needs of clients around the world.Workplace:Rio de Janeiro, 100% on-siteContract Type:InternshipPosition Description
We are looking for a motivated and curious Research Intern to join our Research team, with a focus onLatin America’s, particularly Argentina’s, macroeconomic and financial environment. This position is ideal for students who are eager to learn and develop their skills in economic and financial research.
The selected candidate must benative orfluent in Spanish and English (mandatory)and will support the research team in conducting studies, preparing financial reports, and assisting senior analysts in day-to-day activities.Please note:Resumes will only be accepted if written English. Applications submitted in Portuguese will not be considered.Main Responsibilities
·Support the preparation of financial reports on companies and the monitoring of key economic and financial indicators.
·Assist in preparing summaries and basic analyses of market trends, economic projections, and corporate earnings.
·Help monitor economic events, public policy changes, and macroeconomic data that may impact financial markets.
·Track the performance and movements of financial assets.
·Assist in the development of financial models for company valuation, under the guidance of senior analysts.
·Support data collection, organization, and basic analysis.
·Assist with administrative and operational tasks such as organizing meetings, reports, and presentation materials.
·Collaborate in the preparation of materials for internal use and for investor or market communications.Requirements
·Fluent Spanish and fluent English (mandatory).
·Currently pursuing a degree in Economics, Business Administration, Engineering, Accounting, or related fields.
·Basic understanding of financial concepts such as financial statements, company valuation, and financial instruments.
·Ability to read and interpret financial statements and corporate reports.
·Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with attention to detail.
·Good Excel skills (formulas, basic financial modeling).
·Clear and structured written communication skills.
·Willingness to learn, curiosity about financial markets, and interest in economic trends and global events.Differentials
·Previous internship or academic experience in finance, economics, or capital markets.
·Familiarity with financial information platforms such as Bloomberg or Reuters.
·Knowledge of basic programming or data analysis tools (e.g., Python, VBA, Power BI).Benefits
·Hands-on learning experience in a global company with a strong presence in the fixed income market.
·Exposure to macroeconomic analysis, company research, and financial markets in Lat Am.
·Continuous learning, mentoring, and professional development.
·Collaborative, dynamic, and supportive work environment.

title: Senior key account executive
description:
1. About Us
Keeta is the international arm of Meituan , one of the world’s leading delivery platforms. We’re on a mission to revolutionize how people access food and daily essentials globally. Basic data analysis skills and proficiency in office software applications; experience working with reports and charts is required;
High level of integrity, responsibility, resilience, and teamwork; proactive and passionate about work;
English is mandatory.
4. Why Join Us?
Be part of the global expansion of Meituan’s food delivery revolution. At Keeta, you’ll experience firsthand the fast-paced growth and transformation of a cutting-edge industry. Join a diverse, world-class team that encourages bold thinking and global collaboration. This is more than just a job—it’s a chance to unlock your potential, expand your international outlook, and contribute meaningfully to innovation on a global scale.

title: Técnico de meio ambiente
description:
A ACOEM Ambiental busca um(a) Técnico(a) Ambiental para atuar no suporte técnico e operacional dos programas ambientais, garantindo conformidade legal, organização dos processos e melhoria contínua das rotinas ambientais.
Se você tem perfil técnico, organizado e gosta de atuar próximo a órgãos reguladores e auditorias, essa oportunidade pode ser para você.
Principais responsabilidades
Elaborar, acompanhar e controlar processos ambientais (licenças, fiscalizações, autos de infração e despachos técnicos)
Atuar em todas as fases dos processos ambientais, avaliando relatórios e manifestações técnicas
Elaborar e revisar procedimentos operacionais conforme legislação e boas práticas ambientais
Atender demandas técnicas e administrativas de órgãos reguladores
Planejar rotas e cronogramas para vistorias, auditorias e fiscalizações
Apoiar a elaboração de relatórios técnicos, planos de trabalho, inventários ambientais e PGRS
Apoiar auditorias internas e externas, consolidando informações e evidências
Contribuir para treinamentos, certificações e programas ambientais

Apoiar o acompanhamento de metas e indicadores de sustentabilidade

Curso Técnico em Meio Ambiente (concluído e reconhecido pelo MEC)
Conhecimento em legislação ambiental (federal, estadual e municipal)
Experiência com licenciamento ambiental e atendimento a órgãos fiscalizadores
Elaboração e análise de relatórios técnicos ambientais
Planejamento e execução de vistorias e auditorias ambientais
Desejáveis:
Graduação em Gestão Ambiental, Engenharia Ambiental ou áreas correlatas
Vivência em consultoria ambiental ou ambientes industriais

Conhecimento em ISO 14001 e sustentabilidade corporativa
Noções de geoprocessamento (QGIS / Arc GIS)
Excel intermediário

Proatividade e senso de melhoria contínua
Comunicação clara

Compromisso com sustentabilidade, inovação e excelência técnica
